violations.text: The Person in charge did not assure compliance with critical code requirements. Management's plan for assessing, monitoring, and controlling foodborne disease hazards is inadequate. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 08/17/2026
No person certified in food safety was present as needed at the time of inspection. Staff scheduled to take food safety manager course. New Violation. Correct By: 08/31/2026

Raw animal foods raw beef and raw pork were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods such as cooked foods and sauces in the walk-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Foods were replaced during time of inspection and guidance document posted on walk-in cooler door. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 08/31/2026

The quaternary ammonium concentration in the sanitizing solution of the 3-bay sink was 0 parts per million (ppm). According to the manufacturer's use directions, the concentration of the quaternary ammonium must be 200-400 ppm. Additional sanitizer was added to water at 3 bay sink at time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/31/2026

Various cooked foods were observed held at 45-48 degrees Fahrenheit in walk-in cooler. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Time/temperature abused foods were voluntarily disposed of. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 08/31/2026

The door to the outside, located in the dining area, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 08/31/2026

Walk-in cooler was observed at ambient temperatures of 47-48 degrees Fahrenheit. Walk-in cooler was taken out of service to hold foods that require refrigeration for food safety during time of inspection. No foods to be stored in walk-in cooler until unit can maintain an internal food temperature of 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below. Proof of repairs to be provided to inspector prior to use. Establishment is limited to cook/serve food preparation at this time due to refrigeration. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2026
The Person in charge did not assure compliance with critical code requirements. New Violation. Correct By: 08/17/2026

Raw animal foods raw beef, raw pork, raw hamburgers were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods such as cooked foods and sauces in the walk-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Foods were replaced during time of inspection and guidance document provided. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/17/2026

Staff failed to sanitize equipment and utensils after washing and rinsing them. After being cleaned, equipment and utensils must be sanitized in the 3-bay-sink or dishwasher. 3 bay sink with chlorine sanitizer was set up during time of inspection and guidance document provided during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/17/2026

Various cooked foods were observed held at 45-60 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Time/temperature abused foods were voluntarily disposed of. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/17/2026

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Cooked beans were observed cooling on the counter in large buckets temping at 110 degrees Fahrenheit, foods were assessed and placed into shallower containers to continue cooling process during time of inspection. Cooling methods reviewed and guidance document provided during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/17/2026

Chicharron and helados packaged in the food establishment are lacking labels. Food packaged in a food establishment must be labeled with the common name of the food, a list of ingredients, the quantity of the contents, and the business name/address. Guidance document for food labelling provided. New Violation. Correct By: 08/24/2026

The door to the outside, located in the dining area, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 08/31/2026

Domestic feline litter in plastic container and domestic feline food were observed under 3 bay sink. Items were removed during time of inspection. PIC informed to cease practice. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/17/2026

Walk-in cooler was observed at ambient temperatures of 45-46 degrees Fahrenheit. Walk-in cooler was taken out of service to hold foods that require refrigeration for food safety during time of inspection. No foods to be stored in walk-in cooler until unit can maintain an internal food temperature of 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below. Establishment is limited to cook/serve food preparation at this time due to refrigeration. New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2026

Wood is used in the construction of the retail shelving and counter in the front counter area. Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other food soiling or that require frequent cleaning must be constructed of a nonabsorbent and smooth material. New Violation. Correct By: 04/13/2026

The condensate from the walk-in cooler is draining into a container. Condensate drainage and other nonsewage liquids must drain into a drain. PIC states plumber is scheduled to repair. New Violation. Correct By: 04/13/2026
